title: 第一章 迟到六十年的外挂第二章 周天混元吐息法
content_zh:
高山村。
晨光熹微，红彤彤的太阳刚从群山之中抬起了头，金云横挂在天空，片片薄云在日光下迸射出道道红光。
从始至终，鸡鸣不惊，狗儿不叫。
村子最东头的高山上，一个方方正正如四点金般的古朴道观，横亘在高山中央，微风吹来，为这道观增添了几分的气势。
青砖斑驳，门户厚重，三两棵小草从墙根处发芽，露出了几点翠绿，大树上滴落的露珠晶莹剔透，给道观添了几分水汽与生机。
道观不大但却透着几分的生活。
院子中也收拾的利索，院落中央，师徒三人舒展着手脚，拉伸着筋骨，在阳光下透出道道残光。
双手托天，抻筋拔骨，左右弯弓……
看似像是八段锦，但隐约间却又透着几分的生活气，招式不紧不慢，宋风一边抻着筋骨一边缓动着身躯，不惊不喜，面色平淡。
身后两个徒弟年轻气盛，伸筋拔骨之间还有汗滴流露，一拳一脚带着几分青年的力气劲儿，左右动作虽然标准，但更突出一种刚猛，刚好与这年纪匹配。
大徒弟宋诚已经十八了，打拳时更多了几分的力量，双眼认真，好似在完成师父的任务。
二徒弟宋志年仅十五，小眼睛滴溜溜直转，同样在练功，却让人感受到一股通透的机灵劲儿。
道观外传来一阵欢声笑语。
大开的道观门外，几个身强体壮的汉子，身上背着几把弓箭，手中拿着不知传了多少代，磨的锃光瓦亮的老叉子，在道观门前经过。
如今春意正浓。
土地里那几亩粮食早就种好了，如今这些精壮汉子有了时间，正打算往山里整些野味，弄些果子回来贴补家用。
笑声中有一精壮汉子，大笑着看向了道观之中练功的几人:
“老爷子如今山中猎物蹦得正欢快呢，要不陪我们哥几个进山，活动活动身子骨？”
头发带着几分斑白，但眼神中流露着几股精气神的宋风波澜不惊，带着不浓不淡的笑意看向了这几个壮汉。
见到他们准备充足，对着这几个人摇头笑道:

“老喽，筋骨没你们这些年轻人壮实，回来的时候别忘了在山中采些草药，到时候拿粮食跟你们换。”
听到了宋风如此说，几个汉子笑着闹着，提刀弯弓，擎着钢叉走到宋风正前的时候，还各自点头，随即便向着山林中走去。
看着这些汉子绕过这山头，向着其他地方走去，宋风双眼波澜不惊，目光平静，表情泰然。
转过头去看着两个打拳打的汗沉沉，带着好奇之色，眼睛滴溜溜直转的宋志，宋风摇头笑了笑，随即看向了这新老交替，心中杂陈的道观。
晨练完成。
伙房里面热腾腾的，早饭也早就已经温好，锅里面除了蒸好的馒头还有半锅的米汤之外，除此之外，每个人碗中还多了一块肉干。
肉干漆黑，约莫食指长短，看起来黑漆漆的，但蒸煮好的肉干中带的水分，勾动空气中的肉味，让人忍不住垂涎欲滴。
肉在高山村中可是个稀罕玩意儿。
这个时代，寻常人家别说是顿顿吃肉，就算是顿顿馒头，米汤，日子也都已经说得上是极好的了，大部分人家大多吃的都是杂粮野菜混合的黑面馍馍。
对于吃食宋风，向来舍得。
高山村地处深山，周围都是些荒山野岭，整个村子百十里几乎都没什么人烟，什么钱财全都是身外之物，唯有粮食才是真的。
吃到嘴里，消化在肚子里，长在身上的肉里，这才是真东西。
content_en:
Alpine village.
The morning light was dim, and the red sun had just raised its head from the mountains. Golden clouds hung horizontally in the sky, and thin clouds shot out red light in the sunlight.
From beginning to end, the cock crows without alarm and the dog does not bark.
On the high mountain at the east end of the village, there is a simple Taoist temple that is square and square like four golden pins. It lies in the middle of the mountain. The breeze blows, adding a bit of momentum to this Taoist temple.
The green bricks are mottled and the door is thick. A few small grasses sprout from the base of the wall, revealing a bit of green. The dewdrops dripping from the big trees are crystal clear, adding a bit of moisture and vitality to the Taoist temple.
The Taoist temple is not big but it reveals a bit of life.
The courtyard was also neatly tidied up. In the center of the courtyard, the three masters and apprentices stretched their hands and feet, stretching their muscles and bones, revealing the residual light in the sunlight.
Hold the sky with both hands, stretch the muscles and pull out the bones, bend the bow left and right...
It looks like a Baduanjin, but it has a vague sense of life. The moves are unhurried and unhurried. Song Feng stretches his muscles and bones while moving his body slowly. He is not surprised or happy, and his face is calm.
The two apprentices behind him were young and energetic, with drops of sweat dripping from them as they stretched their muscles and bones. Their punches and kicks had a bit of youthful strength. Although their left and right movements were standard, they highlighted a fierceness that was just in line with their age.
The eldest disciple Song Cheng is already eighteen years old. He has a little more strength when punching, and his eyes are serious, as if he is completing the master's task.
The second apprentice, Song Zhi, is only fifteen years old. His little eyes are rolling and he is also practicing, but he has a clear and clever energy.
There was a burst of joy and laughter outside the Taoist temple.
Outside the wide open door of the Taoist temple, several strong men, carrying several bows and arrows on their backs and holding old forks that had been passed down for countless generations and were polished to a bright shine, passed by in front of the Taoist temple.
Now spring is coming.
The few acres of food in the land have been planted long ago. Now that these strong men have time, they are planning to pack some game in the mountains and bring back some fruits to supplement their family income.
Among the laughter was a strong man, who laughed and looked at the people practicing in the Taoist temple:
"Old man, the prey is jumping happily in the mountains now. Why don't you accompany us brothers into the mountains to stretch your body?"
Song Feng, who had a bit of gray hair but some energy in his eyes, looked at these strong men with a moderate smile.
Seeing that they were well prepared, he shook his head at these people and said with a smile:
"I am an old man. My muscles and bones are not as strong as those of you young people. Don't forget to pick some herbs in the mountains when you come back. I will exchange them with you for food."
After hearing what Song Feng said, several men laughed and made noise, raised their knives, bent their bows, and held up their steel forks. When they walked in front of Song Feng, they each nodded and then walked towards the mountain forest.
Watching these men go around the mountain and towards other places, Song Feng's eyes were calm, his eyes were calm, and his expression was calm.
Turning his head to look at the two sweaty Song Zhi who were fighting with curiosity, Song Feng shook his head and smiled, and then looked at the old and new Taoist temple with mixed feelings in his heart.
Morning exercise completed.
The kitchen was steaming hot, and breakfast had already been warmed up. In addition to the steamed buns and a half-filled pot of rice soup, there was also an extra piece of dried meat in each person's bowl.
The dried meat is dark, about the length of your index finger, and looks pitch black, but the moisture in the steamed dried meat stirs up the smell of meat in the air, making people salivate.
Meat is a rare thing in high mountain villages.
In this era, ordinary people's lives are considered to be excellent, not to mention eating meat every day, even steamed buns and rice soup. Most people eat black-faced steamed buns mixed with grains and wild vegetables.
Song Feng has always been willing to eat.
Gaoshan Village is located deep in the mountains, surrounded by barren mountains and wild ridges. There are almost no people in the entire village for hundreds of miles. All money is external, and only food is real.
eatIn the mouth, digested in the stomach, and grown in the flesh of the body, this is the real thing.
